name: Allopurinol
advice: Take after food. Drink plenty of water during the day.

name: Amlodipine
advice: Take at the same time each day.

name: Amoxicillin
advice: Space the doses evenly through the day.

name: Aspirin (low dose)
advice: Take with food to protect the stomach.

name: Atenolol
advice: Take at the same time each day.

name: Atorvastatin
advice: Can be taken at any time of day.

name: Azithromycin
advice: Take once a day at the same time.

name: Bisoprolol
advice: Take in the morning at the same time each day.

name: Cetirizine
advice: Some people feel a little sleepy. Taking it in the evening can help.

name: Chlorphenamine (chlorpheniramine)
advice: This medicine often causes sleepiness.

name: Ciprofloxacin
advice: Take 2 hours before or 6 hours after antacids, iron, calcium or zinc.

name: Clopidogrel
advice: Do not stop before talking to your doctor.

name: Diazepam
advice: Causes sleepiness. Usually for short-term use.

name: Doxycycline
advice: Stay upright for 30 minutes after each dose, so not at bedtime. Keep 2 hours away from antacids, iron or calcium.

name: Empagliflozin
advice: Take in the morning. Drink enough fluids.

name: Enalapril
advice: A dry cough can happen. Tell your pharmacist if it starts.

name: Famotidine
advice: Often taken at bedtime.

name: Fluoxetine
advice: Take in the morning so it does not keep you awake at night.

name: Furosemide
advice: Take in the morning, or by early afternoon, so you do not need to pass urine at night.

name: Gabapentin
advice: Can cause sleepiness and dizziness.

name: Glipizide
advice: Take about 30 minutes before a meal. Do not skip the meal.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
advice: Take in the morning so you do not need to pass urine at night.

name: Ibuprofen
advice: Take with food or milk to protect the stomach.

name: Levothyroxine
advice: Take on an empty stomach, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.

name: Loratadine
advice: Take once a day.

name: Lorazepam
advice: Causes sleepiness. Usually for short-term use.

name: Losartan
advice: Take at the same time each day.

name: Metformin
advice: Take with meals to reduce stomach upset.

name: Metronidazole
advice: No alcohol during the course and for at least 3 days after.

name: Montelukast
advice: Usually taken in the evening.

name: Naproxen
advice: Take with food or milk to protect the stomach.

name: Omeprazole
advice: Take 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.

name: Pantoprazole
advice: Can be taken with or without food. Take at the same time each day.

name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)
advice: Check other medicines for hidden paracetamol.

name: Paracetamol + caffeine
advice: Contains paracetamol. Do not take with other paracetamol products.

name: Prednisone
advice: Take in the morning with food.

name: Rosuvastatin
advice: Can be taken at any time of day.

name: Sertraline
advice: It can take a few weeks to feel the full benefit.

name: Simvastatin
advice: Usually taken in the evening.

name: Sitagliptin
advice: Take once a day with or without food.

name: Tamsulosin
advice: Take 30 minutes after the same meal each day. Stand up slowly.

name: Tramadol
advice: Can cause sleepiness and constipation.

name: Warfarin
advice: Take at the same time each day. Keep the amount of leafy green vegetables steady.
